metas.name: Love Story
metas.description: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: In a world where everyone develops a power on their 18th birthday, Jen didn't. She's turning 25 and is still waiting to get hers. Adrift in a big, confusing world and armed with nothing but a bit of hope and a lot of desperation, Jen begins her journey to find her maybe-superpower. But in doing so, she might discover the joy of being just kind of ok.

metas.name: Misfits
metas.description: When five young outsiders on Community Service get caught in a strange storm, they discover that they have developed superpowers.

metas.name: Next Level Baker
metas.description: Talented bakers compete through three challenging rounds, crafting spectacular seasonal treats. Only one will emerge victorious and be crowned the ultimate holiday champion.
